caption: The drawing features a symmetrical floral design composed of bold, solid colors including red, mustard yellow, and blue, set against a plain off-white background. Central to the composition is a large stylized flower at the top, primarily blue with six yellow petals forming an arc, a red semicircular center, and smaller red accents along the outer edge. This flower has a blue stem that extends vertically downward and branches out into several leaves and flowers. Flanking the main stem are four tulip-shaped flowers—two on each side—with red petals and mustard yellow inner petals, and two smaller blue leaves with mustard yellow accents. Near the base, a cluster of blue leaves fans out horizontally. At the very bottom of the design is a geometric motif resembling a crown or sunburst, consisting of a blue base, a curved yellow band, and four red triangular shapes extending upward. The overall drawing is flat and stylized rather than naturalistic, with no shading or gradients. The text at the bottom reads: “FROM A BOX 1777” and indicates it is from the "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania."
title: Plate 1: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
